g.text: PR #2392 · Trustworthy Muse context and call telemetry
Muse had no context gauge, and run call counts disappeared.
Verified single-call context and durable terminal counters now reach the UI.
BEFORE
AFTER
finalize_turn_metrics
model_context_window and context_snapshot_tokens: None
Known 1M-context models still have no gauge.
RunUsage
Only per-model token totals are consumed.
Completed, failed and cancelled calls disappear.
context_tokens
Muse falls back to whole-run input_tokens.
Multiple model calls are not one context snapshot.
MuseModel::context_limit
Known model window comes from the SDK catalog.
One completed matching-model call supplies a snapshot.
MuseTerminalTelemetry / MuseCallCounts
Latest usage joins the matching command and run stream.
Existing durable terminal keeps counts through reload.
context_tokens / task-card footer
Unknown Muse occupancy hides the gauge.
Footer labels completed, failed and cancelled calls.
Multi-call occupancy stays unknown. Failed calls are not proof of a stream retry; stream_restarts stays unchanged.
